comparison.objective: Place two projectors at throw distances that fill their respective screens; candidate commissions a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests equipment transport, distance/orientation adjustment, and projected-image fit; candidate tests inserted-tool manipulation, counterholding, fine mechanical adjustment, locking, and iterative impact diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both projected images to fill their screens; candidate requires two bounded dynamic stops without bottoming, hard-stop contact, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve iterative adjustment from an observed outcome, but image-geometry setup and dynamic energy-control commissioning are meaningfully different tested abilities. No specs or image-fill/focus tolerances are available.
